Does Podscribe use AI in its podcast advertising measurement?

Yes, AI and machine learning power Podscribe’s transcription, airchecks, and verification. Automated speech recognition converts podcast content into transcripts, then 18+ checks validate ad placement, duration, and talking points. This automation gives advertisers transparency without manual review, ensuring ads run as promised and measurement data is trustworthy.
